about: A Go library and tools for working with MP4 video and audio files.

prs.title: Cropped audio files can be played again
prs.broken: Cutting an audio-only MP4 with mp4ff-crop could write a file that ffmpeg and players could not open, because one table of sample positions came out wrong.
prs.changed: The crop now writes that table correctly when the cut falls inside the first block of samples.
prs.matters: Trimmed audio files open and play as expected.
